item.text: {"winner":"B","confidence":"high","summary":"B follows the frozen architecture: it adds the convenience API, uses the established multipart helper, and delegates through the unchanged Add method. A improves retry testing but violates the explicit requirement to preserve Add’s behavior.","reasons":["B calls multipartbody.NewFile(\"file\", fileName, content) and passes its replayable body directly to s.Add with opts unchanged.","B preserves Add, keeping its validation, option handling, request construction, response decoding, and error semantics centralized as required.","A changes Add to eagerly read and buffer every caller-supplied multipart body, altering memory usage, reader-error timing, and streaming behavior despite the explicit preservation requirement.","A’s Upload bypasses Add through a new private add method, creating a second path that can drift from Add’s validation or future behavior."],"risks_a":["The io.ReadAll change can unexpectedly buffer large custom multipart bodies and changes established lower-level API semantics.","Neither added Upload test explicitly covers empty filename, nil content, or source-reader failures."],"risks_b":["The retry test checks request count but does not read and verify multipart filename/content on both attempts, so it does not fully prove streamed-content replay.","The added tests omit explicit validation and source-reader error cases required by the contract.","The retry test does not mirror the reported RetryAllMethods: true configuration."]}
